ns2:course.label: HRM in Leisure Organizations
ns2:course.description: Concepts, principles, and objectives of supervision; the nature of the supervisory relationship; supervisory functions and processes; identification and application of methods and techniques; organizational and operational patterns of supervision in recreation and park settings.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Recreation, Sport, and Tourism major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course will only be offered to undergraduates.
